criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 4, 9 and 3 good and measured; 6 a flat plate with a seam and cast fraction 0.038; 2's kit cars read as toys; 8's hem a sawtooth over flat wheel discs; 7's pads near invisible; 5's lamp pool not from the lamp.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One floodlit world, plant wall motif on 1, 4 and 9, dark value track; the reliefs and 7's site sit outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every slide quote matches the extraction and absences are scoped. Charges: slide 3 turns a ratio of floors into a ratio of capacities; the web dek's 'still reads Construction' asserts an earlier quarter nobody fetched; slide 9 and the caption present a closed list where the source says 'including ... and other factors'; the web intro leans toward the rejected publication date.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened is clear; no county, plant name, deadline or action; the stake is abstract.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 5 turns, 9 lands; 6 and 7 step off the line; 8 arrives late.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean on every house rule; a table-reading register with nothing regional.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Floodlit world repeats no. 55, taped empty bays repeat no. 56, the close is again an absence.

hard_fails: An unverified fact presented as verified on a published surface. ledger/articles/2026-10-24.json dek reads 'The Texas row for Optimus, its humanoid robot, still reads Construction.' No claim gives an earlier quarter's status for that row, so 'still' asserts a prior state nobody fetched.
one_sentence_fix: Read every comparative and temporal word against its claim quote, starting with slide 3's ratio of floors and the web dek's 'still'.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat grey plate with a hard seam; blocks barely proud (cast fraction 0.038).
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Blocks and offcut as proud as slide 3's stop blocks with casts of 50 px or more; plate under the type with a falloff, no seam.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Sepia clay kit cars, mismatched bodies; no black sky or lit lamp row.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Three identical primer grey bodies, a visible lit high bay row, a true black back wall.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Sawtooth hem over flat wheel discs; reads as a tall hatchback.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: One smooth drape to the carrier deck hiding the wheels; a lower fastback roofline.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The taped pads are nearly invisible; accent 0.0000.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera down and in so the nearer taped pad fills the lower third inside the lit wedge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The pool is not from the unlit lamp; crate a flat panel; faint casts.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Aim and light the lamp at the bolt group so its casts run long across the footprint.
